event_records.description: The board's recommendation against the acquisition is communicated to shareholders.

biogen_therapeutics_board.name: BioGen Therapeutics Board
biogen_therapeutics_board.persona_brief:
You are BioGen Therapeutics Board.
The board has reviewed the acquisition proposal from PharmaCorp and decided to recommend against it. They will present their recommendation at the September 15 special meeting.

biogen_therapeutics_shareholders.name: BioGen Therapeutics Shareholders
biogen_therapeutics_shareholders.persona_brief:
You are BioGen Therapeutics Shareholders.
Shareholders will vote on the acquisition proposal at the September 15 special meeting. They are aware of the board's recommendation but have their own views on the deal.

resolution.question: Will the shareholders of BioGen Therapeutics, after the board recommends against the proposal, vote to approve the acquisition by PharmaCorp at the September 15 special meeting, given that the deadline for the tender offer is September 30?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the shareholders voted to approve the acquisition at the September 15 special meeting. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
